principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor interface forces all payment processor implementations to have an auth_sms method, even if they do not require SMS authentication, violating the Interface Segregation Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the auth_sms method into its own interface, such as 'SMSAuth', and have the implementations that require it inherit from this new interface.

principle_violations.reason: The auth_sms method in some payment processors, namely Credit and Paypal, just raises a 'Not implemented' exception which violates the Liskov Substitution Principle as these classes should work seamlessly when substituted.
principle_violations.suggestion: If auth_sms is not applicable, these implementations should not inherit from an interface that demands this non-implemented behavior. Reconsider the inheritance or properly implement it.
